text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Mom, Dad! I got to talk to City-san, my 
idol, this morning! She was askin' about 
my race, and it made me so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I talked on the phone with Mifuyu-chan 
yesterday too, and she told me, 'Even if 
we're far apart, our hearts are 
together'..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I got super fired up! I resolved to run 
every single step with all my might and 
headed out to the race!"
